name: Sakanoue Mikana
source:
One year younger than the protagonist, Mikana is the daughter of a high-class family. She has poor communication skills and is the sole member of the Tea Ceremony Club. She's occasionally seen swimming alone in the pool...

[translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=724789]Getchu[/url]]
